svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The anon account: what everyone sees, and what Totem adds
svg.desc: Left: any Farcaster app sees an anon post from an account with no name, arriving in hourly batches, top-level only, with nothing saying who wrote it. Right: Totem shows the same post with up to six extra layers: a member badge from the proof (planned), a marker that it is yours on your own screen (built, test data only), an optional public reveal (built, test data only), a reveal to chosen friends (built, test data only, as rings), threading with your personas (planned) and your modes (built, test data only). Bottom: the path a post takes, from the composer through a membership proof, a random wait and an hourly batch to the anon account.
